title: Pure Barian's
summary: The Barian's and Seventh Spell/Trap engine paired with the Level 4 WATER Shark core and Over-Hundred Numbers (Number 101 through Number 106). By combining one-card Rank 4/Rank 5 WATER starters with Rank-Up-Magic Spells, the deck fields Chaos Numbers and stacks CXyz Barian Hope with up to 7000 ATK.

summary.title: Starters
points: Seventh Tachyon reveals an Over-Hundred Number in the Extra Deck to search any monster matching its Type/Attribute or Level/Rank, finding Abyss Shark, Buzzsaw Shark, or Silent Angler.
Seventh Ascension adds or places on top of the Deck any Seventh or Barian's Spell/Trap, including Barian's Chaos Draw, Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force, or Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One.

Buzzsaw Shark targets a WATER monster to Special Summon a Fish of the same Level from the Deck, while Abyss Shark Special Summons itself when you control only WATER monsters and searches a Level 3, 4, or 5 Fish.

summary.title: Opening: Seventh Ascension + Abyss Shark
steps: Activate Seventh Ascension to search Barian's Chaos Draw or Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force, or stack Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One on top of the Deck for your next Draw Phase.
Normal Summon Buzzsaw Shark and Special Summon Crystal Shark or Silent Angler, or Special Summon Abyss Shark to search Crystal Shark and treat them as Level 5s for a Number Xyz Summon.
Xyz Summon N.As.H. Knight (Rank 5) or Number 101: Silent Honor ARK / Number 106: Giant Hand (Rank 4), then upgrade via CXyz N.As.Ch. Knight or a Rank-Up-Magic Spell into a Chaos Number.

summary.title: N.As.H. Knight & Over-Hundred Climb
summary.text: N.As.H. Knight cannot be destroyed by battle while a Number monster is on the field and detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect during either Main Phase to attach an Over-Hundred Number (Number 101 through 107) from your Extra Deck alongside another face-up monster on the field as Xyz Material. Ranking up into CXyz N.As.Ch. Knight then detaches a material to Special Summon a Number C101 through C107 directly from the Extra Deck on top of it, setting up CXyz Barian Hope.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: CXyz Barian Hope can be Xyz Summoned on top of any Number C101 through C107, gains 1000 ATK for every Xyz Material attached to it, and copies the name and effect of any Number monster in your GY.
Number C101: Silent Honor DARK attaches an opposing Special Summoned monster as material without detaching and revives itself from the GY while healing LP equal to its original ATK.

Number C106: Giant Red Hand negates the effects of all other face-up cards on the field as a Quick Effect, while Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade pops a Spell/Trap on summon and negates monster effects on the field or in the hand.
Number 103: Ragnazero and Number C103: Ragnafinity punish modified-ATK monsters with quick destruction, draws, burn, and banishing.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Barian's Chaos Draw either sends a Normal Rank-Up-Magic Spell from the Deck to copy its effect immediately or summons up to 2 monsters from the Deck to Xyz Summon a Number.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force, Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force, and the Quick-Play Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos upgrade Rank 4 Numbers into Rank 5 Chaos Numbers during your Main or Battle Phase.
Barian Untopia protects your Over-Hundred Numbers, Chaos Numbers, and CXyz monsters from targeting and effect destruction, and Seventh Eternity revives Over-Hundred Numbers from the GY.

allow.Silent Angler: Special Summons itself if you control a WATER monster to make an instant Rank 4 Over-Hundred Number.
allow.Abyss Shark: Special Summons itself if you control only WATER monsters and searches a Level 3, 4, or 5 Fish, doubling Number battle damage.
allow.Crystal Shark: Special Summons itself from hand or GY by targeting a WATER monster and can be used as a Level 3 or 4 for Number Xyz Summons.
allow.Buzzsaw Shark: Summons a Level 4 Fish from the Deck to immediately make Number 101 or Number 103.
allow.Number 101: Silent Honor ARK: Iconic Over-Hundred Number that detaches 2 materials to attach an opponent's Special Summoned monster.
allow.Number C101: Silent Honor DARK: Chaos Number that attaches an opposing monster without detaching and revives itself while gaining LP.
allow.Number 103: Ragnazero: Over-Hundred Number that destroys an opponent's monster with modified ATK and draws a card.
allow.Number C103: Ragnafinity: Chaos Number that burns the opponent and banishes their monster when its ATK changes.
allow.Number 104: Masquerade: Over-Hundred Number that negates monster effects during the Battle Phase and mills.
allow.Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade: Chaos Number that pops a Spell/Trap on summon and negates monster effects while halving opponent's LP.
allow.Number 106: Giant Hand: Over-Hundred Number that detaches 2 materials to negate an opponent's monster effect.
allow.Number C106: Giant Red Hand: Chaos Number that negates all other face-up cards on the field as a Quick Effect.
allow.N.As.H. Knight: Rank 5 Xyz representing Nash that attaches an Over-Hundred Number from Extra Deck and an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect.
allow.CXyz N.As.Ch. Knight: Rank 6 Chaos Xyz that ranks up over N.As.H. Knight and summons any Chaos Number from the Extra Deck.
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos: Quick-Play Rank-Up-Magic that ranks up a Number into its Chaos counterpart during the Battle Phase.

main: Abyss Shark
Special Summons itself and searches Crystal or Buzzsaw Shark, enabling instant Rank 4/5 Over-Hundred Numbers.

One-card Rank 4 starter that summons a Level 4 Fish from the Deck.
Crystal Shark
Recursive extender from hand or GY that enables Rank 4 or Rank 5 Number Xyz Summons.
Silent Angler
Free Level 4 WATER extender from hand.
Seventh Tachyon
Reveals an Over-Hundred Number in the Extra Deck to search any monster matching its Type/Attribute or Level/Rank.
Seventh Ascension
Searches or stacks any 'Seventh' Spell/Trap or 'Barian's' Spell/Trap, including Rank-Up-Magic The Seventh One.
Barian's Chaos Draw
Stacks a Seventh Spell or sends a Rank-Up-Magic from Deck to summon 2 monsters and Xyz Summon.
Rank-Up-Magic - The Seventh One
Activated when drawn during the Draw Phase or copied by Chaos Draw to cheat out an Over-Hundred Number and its Chaos upgrade.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force
Ranks up a Rank 4 Xyz into a Rank 5 Chaos Number or CXyz monster and steals an opponent's Xyz Material.
Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force
Ranks up any Rank 4 Xyz Monster into any Rank 5 Number C monster.
Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos
Quick-Play Rank-Up-Magic that upgrades a Number monster into its Chaos counterpart during the Battle Phase.
Barian Untopia
Field Spell that protects Number C, CXyz, and Over-Hundred Numbers from targeting and effect destruction.
Seventh Eternity
Continuous Trap that revives Over-Hundred Numbers and attaches Number C monsters to them.
